attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Small, localized change that skips middleware processing when the sub-path normalizes to empty (i.e., request is exactly the media root), which is a narrow edge case unlikely to affect normal asset serving but could subtly change behavior for edge-case requests to the bare media root path."}

reason: Small, localized change that skips middleware processing when the sub-path normalizes to empty (i.e., request is exactly the media root), which is a narrow edge case unlikely to affect normal asset serving but could subtly change behavior for edge-case requests to the bare media root path.
